The 
 maintenance procedures should be done on the power oil filter when the 
 pressure drop across the filter is about 0.5 
 kg/cm2.

Twin filter are used in case the 
 regeneration of the dirty filter element must be carried out without shutting 
 down the plant. The red segment of the indicator disk is visible over a 
 pressure range equal to 20 -100% the first read constant is actuated at 75% 
 and the second at 100%

 initiated by eng. Albir Fayez Gerges, tested by eng. Mohamed El-Sayed Ahmed 
 and eng. Magdi Sami Ebrahim, and approved by eng. Mohamed Salah Eldin Abd 
 Elghafar general director.

 certified by eng. Afaf Ebrahim El-Dib: CEPC inspection & quality control's 
 Head Sector and MPIS coordinator.

A 
work permit must be issued and the qualified 
maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category.

Safety fence with 
caution marks surrounding the work area.

Wear safety helmet, shoes, breathing-mask, 
safety glasses is required.

A 
work permit must be issued and the qualified 
maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category.

Safety fence with 
caution marks surrounding the work area.

Wear safety helmet, shoes, breathing-mask, 
safety glasses is required.

Air 
 Compressor.
Cleaning Fluid

Set the change- over device at its 
 mid- position both filter chamber in use.

Open the air vents of both 
 chambers.
Start the plant up slowly.

Close the air vents when the air 
 has escaped and liquid has started issuing.

Operate the change - over device to 
 isolate one filter chamber while one of the filter chambers is being used for 
 filtering the isolated chamber is in reserve until the maximum permissible 
 differential pressure has built up by the operating filter becoming clogged 
 when the differential pressure reaches 0.8 or 1.2 Kg/cm2 for filter mesh and 
 2 Kg/cm2 for micro-cartridge filters, the change-over is made as follows to 
 the clean filter chamber.

If there is pressure equalizing 
 cock open it by briefly opening the air vent, check whether the reverse 
 chamber is full.
Change- over.
Shut the pressure equalizing cock.

Open the air vent on the isolated 
 filter this replaces the pressure of the liquid and this possible to check 
 whether the change over device has stopped the flow to the filter chamber in 
 contrast to the change over using valve or segment, when there is a change 
 over by plug- cock, complete sealing is not possible: by opening the sludge 
 outlet, liquid leaking during the cleaning process, can be drawn off.

Take the cover off the casing to 
 the isolated filter chamber.

Remove the filter element 
 vertically upwards, in doing so it may be necessary, to reduce the liquid level 
 by opening the sludge outlet.

Clean the filter element, or fit 
 new micro- cartridges. Clean the filter mesh with a suitable cleaning agent 
 assisted by blowing through the mesh from the clean side.
Fix the cleaned filter element.

Put the cover back on the casing, 
 leaving the air vent open. Before putting back cover, make sure that the seal 
 is in good condition and is properly seated, if necessary renew the seal.

If there is a pressure equalizing 
 cock, open it until the air has been vented from the filter half. If there is 
 no pressure equalizing cock, set the change over- device to its mid- position 
 until the air has been vented.

Close the air vent. One of the 
 filter halves is then again in reserve. This procedure, from paragraph 6 on, is 
 repeated as required.
